description: Drive straight until the wall is 2.0 m ahead (front_clearance, the same stop the M02 approach-the-wall plans use), then approach the nearest confirmed chair and stop at the default gap (gap_min(chair) rounded up to 0.1 m). acquire_timeout_sec 5 starts counting when the second move starts, so the chair must be in view from the wall stop. Needs semantic_layer_node (/costmap/semantic_tracks) and the global EKF.
